SELECT g.id, g.subject_name, count(CASE WHEN s.id != g.user_id THEN 1 END) AS totalStudent FROM t_subject g LEFT JOIN t_user_subject ug ON g.id = ug.subject_id LEFT JOIN t_user s ON ug.user_id = s.id and s.is_deleted = 0
g.is_deleted = 0
AND g.user_id = #{id}
GROUP BY g.id HAVING totalStudent > 0
